DIAGNOSIS READY: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) Retinitis

This presentation of granular yellow-white retinal opacities and hemorrhages in an AIDS patient is classic for CMV retinitis, which requires immediate treatment to prevent permanent blindness. We need to start antiviral therapy today, and I will order a CMV PCR test on your blood to confirm the systemic viral load.
